## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2012-03-05: Form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.32 to S-1/A Amendment No. 5.
- 2012-03-21: Vantiv Up-C IPO closes; TRA executed between Vantiv, Inc. and JPDN Enterprises, LLC; 85% of Realized Tax Benefits on Section 743(b) basis adjustments from JPDN's IPO-eve contribution of Class A and Class B Units of Vantiv Holding plus Imputed Interest.
- 2012-05-08: Executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.8 to Q1 2012 10-Q.

#### Termination

- 2013-10-23: Tax Receivable Termination Agreement between JPDN and Vantiv; approximately $0.5M paid; settles this TRA and JPDN's portion of the NPC NOLs TRA.

## Explanation

This JPDN TRA was one of four parallel TRAs Vantiv executed at its March 21, 2012 Up-C IPO. JPDN Enterprises, LLC, the founder vehicle of then-CEO Charles D. Drucker, contributed Class A and Class B Units of Vantiv Holding to Vantiv, Inc. at IPO in exchange for Class A common stock; the resulting Section 743(b) basis step-up was the covered tax attribute, with 85% of Vantiv's Realized Tax Benefits payable to JPDN plus Imputed Interest. The TRA was terminated on October 23, 2013 via a Termination Agreement that simultaneously settled both this TRA and JPDN's share of the NPC NOLs TRA for approximately $0.5M, reflecting JPDN's small relative ownership share of pre-IPO Vantiv Holding. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record and the parallel-TRA mapping.
